caption: The drawing depicts a single, large jug with a rounded body and a narrow neck, topped with a small circular opening. The jug features a single handle that curves from the top of the neck down to the shoulder of the vessel. The object is rendered in muted tones of brown, gray, and tan, with variations in shading and texture to suggest the glazed ceramic surface. There is a slightly darker area where the handle attaches to the body of the jug, and a spot of white highlights on the front of the vessel indicating reflected light. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a small signature with a date near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Cider Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
